followup_rules.question: How should I interpret enrichment versus detection for {subject}?
What do the enrichment rank and comparison mean for {subject}?
What does colocalization support, and what does it not prove, for {subject}?
How do the lead variant and other credible-set candidates differ for {subject}?
Does the molecular QTL evidence establish a disease effect for {subject}?

rules: Aggregate cohort answers omit unrequested individual clinical data.
Clinical stage is recorded metadata; original definitions are preserved in upstream, not supplied as active clinical criteria.
GO evidence code expansions and category distinctions follow official GO documentation.
Model-context omissions do not imply missing database metadata.
Separate QTL indexed relationships from credible-set width, phenotype type and unreturned posterior probabilities.
Matched cell-type counts do not establish the total number profiled by a source study; missing fGSEA contrast is explicitly distinguished from statistical direction.
Full-record fact ledgers preserve source-specific signal roles, assay/method distributions and exact GO expansions without speculative artifact caveats.

QTL source labels do not establish molecular subtype; distinct credible_set record identifiers do not prove independent signals or exclude shared biology, and complete recorded IDs are never described as unnamed.

verified_factual_blocks.reason: Validate canonical factual blocks before display; preserve assay/entity/counting roles; no unrecorded hormone, cognate-cell, artifact or threshold assurances.

readability.reason: Plain-language uncertainty, readable field labels and citation-preserving deduplication; no change to evidence or provider.

rules.text: When describing a gene node, prioritize stable identifiers (HGNC symbol, Ensembl Gene ID) and clearly separate gene-level facts from dataset-derived signals.

When describing a sequence variant node, report the stable variant ID, chr, start_loc, end_loc, ref, alt, type, data_version, and data_source. Treat dbSNP/variant annotation flags as genomic annotation context, not disease causality. Causality requires supporting GWAS/QTL fine-mapping, colocalization, or functional validation edges.

When describing an OCR_peak/regulatory_elements node, report peak ID, chr, start_loc, end_loc, data_source, and type. Treat it as a peak-level open chromatin region. Do not infer target gene, enhancer/promoter function, or regulatory effect unless additional edges or annotations establish that link.PanKgraph currently uses limited OCR peaks from PanKbase snATACseq data. More statistics will coming in future updates

When describing a GO node, report stable GO ID + term name and treat it as functional vocabulary context. Do not convert term membership into a direct mechanistic claim without supporting evidence. Interpret each recorded GO evidence code using its exact glossary name and category. IBA is phylogenetic evidence, ISS is computational similarity evidence, IEA is automatically generated annotation, and TAS is an author statement. These categories are not interchangeable. TAS does not itself assert a direct assay and does not prove that experiments are absent. Count unique GO terms separately from annotation records when multiple evidence codes support one term.

When describing a KEGG pathway node, report KEGG ID, pathway name, link, and data_version. Treat it as pathway vocabulary/context; pathway membership alone is not pathway activation, enrichment, or disease causality.

When describing a Reactome pathway node, report Reactome ID, pathway name, link, and data_version. Treat it as pathway vocabulary/context; pathway membership alone is not pathway activation, enrichment, or disease causality.

When describing an anatomical_structure node, report category, name, source, source_url, and description. Treat it as anatomical/cell-type metadata context. Do not infer gene expression, disease involvement, or sample availability unless linked by the relevant molecular or metadata edge.

When describing a Sample node, report Data Modality, anatomical_structure, note, data_source, and contact when present. Treat samples as provenance records. Do not infer donor-level disease status or molecular findings from a sample node alone without has_sample/has_donor and molecular evidence. Use resolved_constraints to distinguish exact assay labels from verified RNA/ATAC capability matches. HPAP snMultiomics can supply documented RNA and ATAC components; retain that assay label. Protocol capability and indexed samples do not establish availability of downloadable files. Do not infer RNA from a CITE-seq Protein-only record.

For a donor-count or sample-discovery question, lead with unique matching donor and sample counts, the requested cohort/tissue/assay filters, source and file-availability status. Do not add individual antibody, HbA1c, C-peptide, age, sex or other clinical tables unless the user requested those details. A count question does not ask for example donors or clinical interpretation. Preserve recorded t1d_stage, diabetes_type and derived_diabetes_status as separate metadata classifications; do not diagnose, infer new clinical criteria, add a diagnosed-T1D restriction, or resolve differing classifications as a clinical conflict. Report only clinical facts explicitly requested and present in returned evidence. For RNA-capability matches, retain the recorded assay label and separate documented protocol capability from indexed samples and verified downloads. Missing or conflicting clinical fields must not silently exclude a donor. An endpoint stub or omitted field in the model excerpt is not evidence that the Neo4j record lacks metadata; do not discuss these technical omissions in the answer. Empty graph wrappers are not matching donors.

When describing a data_modality node, treat it as assay or measurement context. Use it to clarify whether evidence comes from scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, bulk assays, BCR/TCR-seq, or other modalities; do not convert modality membership into a biological result.

Interpret T1D_DEG_in as recorded RNA differential expression associated with Type 1 Diabetes in its recorded anatomical structure. Preserve the gene and anatomical structure as distinct entity roles. Report recorded direction, Log2FoldChange, SE_of_Log2FoldChange, P_value, Adjusted_P_value, data_version and data_source when present. Do not infer a significance threshold, hormone identity, cognate cell, cell specificity, mechanism or technical-artifact explanation unless separately supported by explicit source evidence. Do not assure absence of contamination from a gene name.

Interpret gene_detected_in as recorded RNA detection support within its condition and anatomical structure, distinct from disease differential expression and cell specificity. Report recorded assay, donor and cell counts, summaries, detection rules and thresholds only when present. Do not supply unrecorded method thresholds or infer technical artifacts or their absence. Returned matching cell types are not necessarily all cell types profiled in the source study; source denominator requires separate evidence.

Interpret gene_enriched_in as recorded cell-type enrichment, distinct from an independently annotated marker relationship, exclusive expression or causality. Preserve recorded condition, comparison, effect_direction, log2FoldChange, padj, expression support and source fields. A recorded one-versus-rest comparison retains the source population irrespective of the query subset. rank_in_cell_type ranks genes within the target cell type. Never infer a hormone/cognate-cell role, unrecorded significance threshold or exclusion of technical artifacts.

Interpret gene_activity_score_in as scATAC-seq-derived gene activity score in an anatomical structure or cell type. This is chromatin accessibility-derived gene activity, not RNA expression and not direct transcription rate. Report OCR_GeneActivityScore_mean and OCR_GeneActivityScore_median overall and by disease status when present. Avoid saying a gene is expressed from this edge alone; use phrasing such as accessibility-derived gene activity signal. Cross-condition differences are descriptive unless statistical testing is explicitly encoded.

Interpret OCR_peak_in as an open chromatin region observed in or assigned to an anatomical structure or cell type. Unlike the old placeholder OCR node guidance, this edge points from a peak-level OCR_peak/regulatory_elements node to context. Report chr, start_loc, end_loc from the OCR node and data_source/description from the edge when present. Treat it as regulatory accessibility context, not proof that the linked region regulates a specific gene unless a separate regulatory link or functional evidence is present.

Interpret effector_gene_of as a CMDKP/HuGeAMP-style prioritized mapping from Type 1 Diabetes evidence to candidate effector gene(s), not definitive mechanistic causality. Parse evidence as supporting evidence classes and sources when possible; report effector_gene_list_url, data_source_url, data_version, and data_source. Avoid treating the disease-gene edge as proof that the gene causes T1D without convergent fine-mapping, perturbation, or functional validation.

Interpret physical_interaction as evidence of protein-level interaction under a specific assay context. Always report experimental_system, experimental_system_type, throughput, and qualifications; avoid assuming interaction strength, direction, or disease relevance unless explicitly encoded.

Interpret genetic_interaction as functional dependency/modification evidence, not direct physical binding. Keep assay context explicit and avoid causal direction claims unless a signed effect is provided.

Interpret function_annotation edges as ontology-based annotation links (membership/context), not proof of mechanism or disease causality. IBA means Inferred from Biological aspect of Ancestor; ISS means Inferred from Sequence or structural Similarity; IEA means Inferred from Electronic Annotation. Use these verified definitions, not guessed expansions. For GO records, distinguish annotation-record count from distinct GO-term count. Preserve the recorded GO evidence code and expand it with the formal glossary term; do not invent unreturned codes as examples.

Interpret fGSEA_enriched_in as pathway-level enrichment in a target anatomical structure or cell type from fGSEA. Report pathway_collection, pathway_term/name, cell_type_label, NES, ES, pval, padj, size, leadingEdge, source_file, data_version, and data_source. NES direction reflects enrichment direction in the ranked statistic, not necessarily upregulation of every pathway gene. Do not convert enrichment into causality or pathway activation without explaining the ranking contrast and supporting evidence. When no ranked contrast is supplied, explicitly say the underlying comparison is not recorded, so the direction cannot be assigned a biological meaning. log2err measures p-value estimation uncertainty, not uncertainty in NES or ES.

Interpret marker_gene_of as external HuBMAP marker-gene annotation for a cell type. Report cell_type_name, gene_symbol, dataset_source, data_version, and source_row when present. Treat it as reference marker support, not PanKgraph differential expression evidence and not proof of exclusivity.

Interpret part_of_GWAS_signal as statistical locus membership (LD/credible-signal context), not proof that the variant is causal. Keep effect/non-effect alleles, method, and genome-build/version context explicit.

Interpret signal_COLOC_with as colocalization evidence of potentially shared association signal between QTL/GWAS credible sets. Coloc only responseble for the QTL/GWAS lead snp. You may find many QTL/ GWAS signals/ edge, but only the one clrearly stated in coloc edges are really coloc

Interpret part_of_QTL_signal as statistical inclusion in a QTL signal/credible set for a specific tissue/context. Do not claim direct regulatory causality for a target gene without convergent evidence. Report QTL class/source when available through data_source (for example eQTL, sQTL, exonQTL, GTEx, INSPIRE), tissue_name, credible_set, pip, nominal_p, lbf, effect_allele, other_allele, slope, n_snp, purity, and data_version. One retrieved QTL relationship is one indexed variant-to-gene association, not the number of variants in the underlying credible set. Use recorded n_snp for the source credible-set size and keep that count distinct from retrieved variants and relationships; never call a set single-variant because one relationship was returned. Tissue scopes the molecular association, not the existence or specificity of the genetic variant. Call the phenotype gene expression only if expression/eQTL is explicitly recorded; an unspecified molecular QTL may concern splicing or another trait. One PIP does not establish the other credible-set probabilities or their ranking. Do not claim that other variants have comparable or higher PIPs without those measurements. A data_source label such as exon is a source annotation, not a verified molecular QTL class. Do not infer splicing, sQTL or a splicing-related phenotype from exon alone, even as a suggestion; report the recorded label and leave the molecular subtype unestablished unless an explicit phenotype/class supports it. Different full credible_set identifiers establish differently identified recorded sets, not statistically independent signals or proof that the records cannot share an underlying biological association. Do not conclude not one shared signal solely because those identifiers differ. Preserve each full credible_set identifier or provide an unambiguous display mapping; do not call a set unnamed when a nonempty full identifier is recorded. Repeated short suffixes such as credibleSet1 can belong to different full identifiers and must remain distinguishable.

Keep recorded RNA differential expression, RNA detection/enrichment, ATAC-derived gene activity and peak accessibility distinct. Preserve condition, anatomical context, source, recorded mean versus median and source comparison. Compute numerical directions from supplied values. Cross-assay directions need not agree and do not establish regulatory causality. Do not infer unrecorded method thresholds or artifact explanations.

Keep recorded RNA differential expression, RNA detection/enrichment, ATAC-derived gene activity and peak accessibility distinct. Preserve condition, anatomical context, source, recorded mean versus median and source comparison. Compute numerical directions from supplied values. Cross-assay directions need not agree and do not establish regulatory causality. Do not infer unrecorded method thresholds or artifact explanations.

When interpreting a genetics-to-gene-to-disease subgraph containing QTL, GWAS, colocalization, and effector-gene edges, separate statistical locus membership, QTL target association, colocalization evidence, and curated/predicted effector-gene evidence. Report PIP, credible set, alleles, tissue, PP.H4.abf, GWAS/QTL signal IDs, evidence sources, and versions when present. Strong language such as causal variant, causal gene, or mechanism requires convergent high-confidence evidence and should otherwise be phrased as prioritized candidate or shared-signal evidence.

When interpreting ontology/pathway subgraphs, separate static annotation membership from enrichment results. GO/KEGG/Reactome annotation says a gene belongs to a term/pathway; fGSEA_enriched_in says a pathway was enriched in a ranked analysis for a context. Report term IDs/names, NES, padj, leadingEdge, pathway_collection, and cell_type_label. Do not infer pathway activation, suppression, or disease causality unless the ranking direction and supporting molecular evidence are explicit.

QTL terminology for these records: a source name such as GTEx or INSPIRE alone is not a molecular-phenotype definition. Use molecular QTL unless an explicit recorded class or supplied verified subtype mapping identifies expression, splicing, or exon QTL. A generic slope does not establish an expression-unit effect. Do not label a generic QTL as eQTL in the opening sentence and then disclaim the subtype later.

For this nonempty donor cohort, start with the number of donors matching the approved scope, including documented assay capabilities. Explain the exact assay-label distinction afterward. Do not open with No donors when the approved capability search returned matching donors. Preserve all counts, provenance and file-availability caveats.

FUNCTION_ANNOTATION.direction_note: Follow recorded source and target semantics; reverse traversal requires an explicit reverse question.
FUNCTION_ANNOTATION.scope_note: Endpoint contexts distinguish GO functional annotations, Reactome pathway membership and MSigDB KEGG_MEDICUS set membership. These sources have independent identities and coverage. GO terms are not pathway nodes. A lexical substring match is a search result, not a declaration of concept equivalence.
